note: Generated by design/tools/bosses_7_10.py. World units. The page design/bosses/arpeggiator.md is made from this data.
name: Arpeggiator
key: G major: G, E minor, C, D

common.arrives: on the last Drop of its Track and stays until it is dead; the music holds its Drop for the whole fight
common.health: the number given is a first guess: tune it with the careful bot until the fight lasts what the page says with the build a player has by then, as was done for Longwave and The Choir; x (1 + 0.5 per extra player)
common.grid: everything it does lands on the song's grid and is computed from the song's clock, so every device in a co-op run sees the same fight with nothing new on the wire
common.reward: a bonus Trio and Shards for each player; the Track ends
common.crowd: half of the Drop's crowd, fodder only, unless the page says otherwise

parts.name: The Machine
parts.what: A console 900 wu wide and 120 deep with a core of radius 70 at its middle behind a shutter, four ports along its lower edge (one for each lane) and above it the chart: a matrix of 4 by 16 dots, gold, 400 by 60 wu, the lit dots the next bar's notes and a white cursor crossing it in time

parts.name: Lanes
parts.what: Four lanes 200 wu wide and 900 long running from the ports. Drawn as five faint lines in the grid's colour with the lane's number at the far end

parts.name: Blocks
parts.what: A note: a danger-coloured bar 90 wu wide and 28 deep on the priority layer, falling along its lane's middle at 420 wu/s. It cannot be shot; a Nova clears the lanes

numbers.place: 380 wu from the players' centre on its side of them; it follows them along its own axis at 120 wu/s and its lanes move with it
numbers.laneOfNote: rank the distinct pitches of the bar's arpeggio from low to high; a note's lane is (its rank mod 4) + 1. For G that is 1 2 3 4 3 2 3 4 1 4 3 4 2 1 4 3

phases.name: Quarter notes
rules: The machine stands above the players and plays the accented notes of the lead: steps 0, 4, 8 and 12 of each bar, one block each, in the lane of its note
Its shutter opens for the first beat of every bar as it loads the next chart: x 2 on the core for that beat; x 1 on the core at other times; the console sheds shots

phases.name: Eighth notes
rules: Every second step: eight blocks a bar
Every fourth bar it moves to the next side of the players (above, right, below, left); its new lanes are drawn dashed for the bar before it moves

phases.name: Two hands
rules: A second machine, white, plays from the side at right angles to the first, so the lanes cross in a grid of sixteen cells
The first plays the lead's quarter notes; the second plays the chord stab's rhythm (steps 0, 3, 6, 9, 12, 14), each hit in the lane of the bar's chord tone in turn
Either core can be hurt; they share the health

weakPoint: the core, x 2 for the first beat of each bar
death: the chart reads GG, every block in flight turns gold and climbs back up its lane as Shards, and the machine plays the arpeggio's last run upward
sound: Each block sounds its own note, on the P3 bell at 0.3, as it passes the row the nearest player is in: with fire held, the blocks and the player's lead are the same tune in unison
The shutter is a woodblock on the One with a sweep opening over the beat
A change of side is a whoosh over the bar before; the second machine arrives with the chord's stab
Death: Shard chirps running up the scale over two beats
